about_the_game:
A mood heavy action-adventure, Unbroken takes players on a grindhouse journey to Crests Edge in search of the traitor Nielsen. With multiple routes to achieve your goal (or even abandon it), the ascent to one of the multiple endings will be a memorable one.

With a unique lore structure and one of a kind audiovisual composition, Unbroken will take players on a trip.

With its social structure and customs, choose and forge your path through Crests Edge.


Over the top visceral bursts of violence. String your combos in a brief, stylish ballet of death before moving on to the next one.

With a timeline that progresses with gameplay, events and backstory evolve based on players' actions and related powerplay happening in the background.

The trail has led you to the kingdom spanning the North, far away from your homeland.

Your word is your bond. You will track down the traitor Nielsen, seeking refuge somewhere in Crests Edge, and bring him to justice, dead or alive.

But be wary, Stranger: the realm is now engulfed in chaos. Along with the Feast of the 3rd Moon and the ongoing Earl's Rebellion, your journey will not be for the faint of heart. You will have five full moons to complete your quest. The clock is ticking!

You will prevail. Take up your arms and go forth and uphold the honour of our crest.

I Will Pray Day and Night For Your Safe Return...

The realm of Crests Edge is large and diverse. Featuring many biomes, classes, and so forth, you will experience how the Township evolves with your ascension to your goal.

It is worth noting that due to the severe classism in the realm, you will witness stark contrasts in technological advancement, architecture, style and attire, and the attitude and language of the characters you encounter.

The lowest-poorest regions are similar to those of medieval times. In contrast, the higher you get, the larger the technological gaps become, with the wealthiest regions being more akin to industrial Victorian / WW1 times.

The game's style is a next-gen re-imagining of classic sprite-based FPP games such as Tekwar, Disruptor(PS1), Witchhaven, etc, whilst aiming for an interpretation of how one would remember these games through rose-tinted glasses. So keeping the sprite retro aesthetic, whilst bringing it into modern times with advanced shaders and lighting, physics and ragdolls, destructible environments and in synch with the dynamic jazzpunk OST, Unbroken is sure to leave an impression.

  • A unique gameplay flow and vibe. Neckbreak players ought to feel right at home.

  • The Resin: the potent oils will grant you bullet time in varying forms. Use them wisely, applying the right resin at the right moment can be a matter of life and death

  • The resin kick: give your enemies a free flying lesson or turn multiple inanimate objects into deadly, large caliber projectiles.

  • Classist-based lore. With ascension into the realm of Crests Edge, players will witness an evolution of technology, style, language, architecture, and more

  • A jazzpunk Original Dynamic Soundtrack by Roland Redwood (previous works include Sinless, Neckbreak

  • Punch through system: combat will be juicy with volumetric blood splashing in all directions, and see through holes ripping through your enemies directly at the point of projectile entry.

content_descriptors.notes: Frequent bursts of violent action, self-medication, mature language and themes.
